## Requirements

### REQ-001 — The ledger Lambda counts Delivery events per day, recipient domain, sending identity and config set, without storing recipient addresses.

**Priority:** P0 · **Type:** functional · **PRD:** §5 story 1; §12 Ledger counter items; A-001

#### SC-001-a — Delivery to 3 gmail recipients yields one counter update of 3  `unit` `green`

- **Given** an SES Delivery notification on 2026-10-24 to 3 gmail.com recipients from no-reply@example.com through config set transactional
- **When** counters_for_event is called
- **Then** one update targets pk AGG#2026-10-24, sk gmail.com#example.com#transactional#DELIVERY with n=3
- **Oracle:** [{pk,sk,n} of u for u in updates] == [{"pk":"AGG#2026-10-24","sk":"gmail.com#example.com#transactional#DELIVERY","n":3}] (ttl checked by SC-001-e)
- **Test doubles:** none — pure function
- **Test:** `tests/test_vdm_coverage_tdd.py::test_sc_001_a_delivery_to_3_gmail_recipients_yields_one_counter_update_of_3`

#### SC-001-b — Counter updates never contain a recipient address  `unit` `green`

- **Given** a Delivery notification to alice@gmail.com and bob@yahoo.com
- **When** counters_for_event is called
- **Then** no field of any update contains "alice" or "bob" or an "@"
- **Oracle:** not any("@" in str(v) or "alice" in str(v) or "bob" in str(v) for u in updates for v in u.values())
- **Test doubles:** none
- **Test:** `tests/test_vdm_coverage_tdd.py::test_sc_001_b_counter_updates_never_contain_a_recipient_address`

#### SC-001-c — Untagged delivery is keyed to config set (none)  `unit` `green`

- **Given** a Delivery notification with no ses:configuration-set tag
- **When** counters_for_event is called
- **Then** the sort key's config-set segment is "(none)"
- **Oracle:** updates[0]["sk"].split("#")[2] == "(none)"
- **Test doubles:** none
- **Test:** `tests/test_vdm_coverage_tdd.py::test_sc_001_c_untagged_delivery_is_keyed_to_config_set_none`

#### SC-001-d — A redelivered SNS message is counted once  `integration` `green`

- **Given** an in-memory DynamoDB fake supporting conditional put and ADD, and one Delivery event with messageId M
- **When** the handler processes the same SNS record twice
- **Then** the counter n equals the recipient count once and one SEEN#M marker exists
- **Oracle:** fake.counter("AGG#2026-10-24", sk)["n"] == 3 AND fake.count(pk="SEEN#M") == 1
- **Test doubles:** DynamoDB replaced by in-memory fake (tests/test_ledger_ingest.py pattern); no AWS
- **Test:** `tests/test_vdm_coverage_tdd.py::test_sc_001_d_a_redelivered_sns_message_is_counted_once`

#### SC-001-e — Counter and marker TTLs follow retention rules  `unit` `green`

- **Given** RETENTION_DAYS=396 and NOW=2026-10-24T00:00Z
- **When** counters_for_event and the marker builder run
- **Then** counter ttl is NOW+396 days and marker ttl is NOW+30 days
- **Oracle:** u["ttl"] == epoch(NOW)+396*86400 AND marker["ttl"] == epoch(NOW)+30*86400
- **Test doubles:** none
- **Test:** `tests/test_vdm_coverage_tdd.py::test_sc_001_e_counter_and_marker_ttls_follow_retention_rules`

### REQ-002 — Recipient domains map to mailbox providers by a static domain map, then by MX record, else Other.

**Priority:** P0 · **Type:** functional · **PRD:** §5 story 2 criterion 3; DL-004; A-002

#### SC-002-a — Consumer Microsoft domains map to Microsoft without DNS  `unit` `green`

- **Given** domains outlook.com, hotmail.com, live.com, msn.com and an MX lookup that raises if called
- **When** classify runs on each
- **Then** every result is "Microsoft" and the MX lookup was not called
- **Oracle:** all(classify(d, mx=raiser) == "Microsoft" for d in doms)
- **Test doubles:** MX lookup replaced by a function that raises
- **Test:** `tests/test_vdm_coverage_tdd.py::test_sc_002_a_consumer_microsoft_domains_map_to_microsoft_without_dns`

#### SC-002-b — Business domain classified by MX suffix  `unit` `green`

- **Given** acme.example whose MX is acme-example.mail.protection.outlook.com and beta.example whose MX is aspmx.l.google.com
- **When** classify runs
- **Then** acme.example is Microsoft and beta.example is Google
- **Oracle:** classify("acme.example", mx=stub) == "Microsoft" AND classify("beta.example", mx=stub) == "Google"
- **Test doubles:** stub MX resolver returning fixed records
- **Test:** `tests/test_vdm_coverage_tdd.py::test_sc_002_b_business_domain_classified_by_mx_suffix`

#### SC-002-c — Unknown or failing MX maps to Other  `unit` `green`

- **Given** a domain whose MX lookup times out and a domain whose MX host matches no provider
- **When** classify runs
- **Then** both results are "Other"
- **Oracle:** classify("t.example", mx=timeout) == "Other" AND classify("u.example", mx=stub) == "Other"
- **Test doubles:** stub resolver raising a timeout
- **Test:** `tests/test_vdm_coverage_tdd.py::test_sc_002_c_unknown_or_failing_mx_maps_to_other`

#### SC-002-d — MX results are cached for 7 days in the data directory  `integration` `green`

- **Given** a temp data dir and a counting stub resolver
- **When** classify runs twice for the same domain 6 days apart, then once more at day 8
- **Then** the resolver is called once for the first two runs and again on day 8
- **Oracle:** resolver.calls == 2 AND (tmp/"providers-mx-cache.json").exists()
- **Test doubles:** stub resolver; real filesystem (tmp_path); injected clock
- **Test:** `tests/test_vdm_coverage_tdd.py::test_sc_002_d_mx_results_are_cached_for_7_days_in_the_data_directory`

### REQ-003 — The Mailbox providers table shows deliveries, complaints, complaint rate (per delivery), permanent bounces and bounce rate (per send, i.e. deliveries + bounces, as SES computes it) per provider for the selected Range, sorted by deliveries, with rates only at or above 1,000 sends. Numerators start no earlier than the first Delivery counter so a window never puts old bounces over new deliveries (fidelity audit 2026-10-24).

**Priority:** P0 · **Type:** functional · **PRD:** §5 story 2; DL-007; DL-008

#### SC-003-a — Rates are complaints over deliveries and bounces over sends  `unit` `green`

- **When** build_breakdowns runs

#### SC-003-b — Rate floor at 1,000 deliveries (boundary)  `unit` `green`

- **Given** providers with 999 and 1,000 deliveries and 1 complaint each
- **When** build_breakdowns runs
- **Then** the 999 row has rates None with reason "too few sends"; the 1,000 row has complaint_rate 0.001
- **Oracle:** r999.complaint_rate is None AND r999.rate_note == "too few sends" AND r1000.complaint_rate == 0.001
- **Test doubles:** none
- **Test:** `tests/test_vdm_coverage_tdd.py::test_sc_003_b_rate_floor_at_1_000_deliveries_boundary`

#### SC-003-c — Rows sorted by deliveries descending  `unit` `green`

- **Given** Google 30,000, Microsoft 12,000, Yahoo 20,000 deliveries
- **When** build_breakdowns runs
- **Then** provider order is Google, Yahoo, Microsoft
- **Oracle:** [r.name for r in providers] == ["Google","Yahoo","Microsoft"]

- **Test:** `tests/test_vdm_coverage_tdd.py::test_sc_003_c_rows_sorted_by_deliveries_descending`

#### SC-003-d — Range scopes counts and rates  `unit` `green`

- **Given** counters on 2026-10-20 (1,500 deliveries) and 2026-08-01 (5,000 deliveries) for Google
- **When** build_breakdowns runs with since=2026-09-24 (30d)
- **Then** Google deliveries is 1,500
- **Oracle:** providers["Google"].deliveries == 1500
- **Test doubles:** none
- **Test:** `tests/test_vdm_coverage_tdd.py::test_sc_003_d_range_scopes_counts_and_rates`

#### SC-003-e — Mailbox providers section renders with rates and the floor note  `acceptance` `green`

- **Given** the dashboard in demo mode
- **When** the page loads and the Range is switched from All to 30d

### REQ-006 — The Advisor raises a finding for a sending domain without a custom MAIL FROM or whose MAIL FROM SPF TXT lacks include:amazonses.com - info when DKIM already aligns (DMARC still passes), high when nothing aligns. A MAIL FROM whose status is not SUCCESS is reported as falling back to amazonses.com instead of having its SPF checked (fidelity audit 2026-10-24 - 4 mediums were redundancy notes, not failures).

**Priority:** P0 · **Type:** functional · **PRD:** §5 story 4 criterion 2; DL-006

#### SC-006-a — Missing custom MAIL FROM follows DKIM alignment  `unit` `green`

- **Given** identity c.example with no MailFromAttributes.MailFromDomain, once with DKIM SUCCESS and once NOT_STARTED and unsigned
- **When** auth_findings runs
- **Then** the mail_from finding is info when DKIM aligns and high when nothing aligns
- **Oracle:** sev("mail_from","c.example") == "info" with DKIM SUCCESS; == "high" with DKIM NOT_STARTED
- **Test doubles:** DNS stub
- **Test:** `tests/test_vdm_coverage_tdd.py::test_sc_006_a_missing_custom_mail_from_is_a_note_when_dkim_aligns_and_high_when_nothing_does`

#### SC-006-b — MAIL FROM SPF without amazonses include follows DKIM alignment  `unit` `green`

- **Given** identity d.example with MAIL FROM bounce.d.example whose TXT is "v=spf1 -all"
- **When** auth_findings runs
- **Then** the spf finding on bounce.d.example is info when DKIM aligns and high otherwise; the grid says why
- **Oracle:** sev("spf","bounce.d.example") == "info" | "high"; checks["d.example"]["spf"] == "fail: lacks include:amazonses.com"
- **Test doubles:** DNS stub
- **Test:** `tests/test_vdm_coverage_tdd.py::test_sc_006_b_mail_from_spf_without_amazonses_include_follows_dkim_alignment`

### REQ-012 — Enabled config sets that do not publish Delivery events to a ledger-subscribed topic, and identity topics without Delivery notifications, produce findings with fix briefs. Open/Click are off by policy (link rewriting) and only count when engagement tracking is configured; a brief never edits a destination whose topic does not already feed the ledger (fidelity audit 2026-10-24 - 15 OPEN/CLICK mediums were false positives and one brief would have paged ops on every delivery).

**Priority:** P0 · **Type:** functional · **PRD:** §5 story 8; DL-003

#### SC-012-a — Config set missing DELIVERY is flagged; OPEN/CLICK only by policy  `unit` `green`

- **Given** config set transactional with event types BOUNCE, COMPLAINT on a ledger-subscribed topic; the same on an email-only ops topic
- **When** publishing_findings runs with and without engagement tracking
- **Then** missing is [DELIVERY] by default and adds OPEN, CLICK only with tracking on; the brief updates the destination only when its topic feeds the ledger, otherwise creates a new one
- **Oracle:** f.missing == ["DELIVERY"]; with engagement_tracking set(f.missing) == {"DELIVERY","OPEN","CLICK"}; "update-configuration-set-event-destination" in brief iff topic.ledger_subscribed
- **Test doubles:** none
- **Test:** `tests/test_vdm_coverage_tdd.py::test_sc_012_a_config_set_missing_delivery_is_flagged_open_click_only_by_policy`

#### SC-012-b — Identity topic without Delivery notifications is an info finding  `unit` `green`

- **Given** identity send0.example.com with bounce and complaint topics but no delivery topic
- **When** publishing_findings runs
- **Then** one info finding whose brief contains "set-identity-notification-topic" and "--notification-type Delivery"
- **Oracle:** f.severity == "info" AND "--notification-type Delivery" in f.brief
- **Test doubles:** none
- **Test:** `tests/test_vdm_coverage_tdd.py::test_sc_012_b_identity_topic_without_delivery_notifications_is_an_info_finding`

- **Given** demo_model()
- **When** it is built
- **Then** breakdowns.providers has at least 3 rows and advisor findings number at least 3
- **Oracle:** len(m["breakdowns"]["providers"]) >= 3 AND len(m["advisor"]["findings"]) >= 3
- **Test doubles:** none
- **Test:** `tests/test_vdm_coverage_tdd.py::test_sc_014_a_demo_model_carries_breakdowns_and_at_least_3_advisor_findings`

### REQ-015 — The dashboard stays read-only and never calls VDM APIs.

**Priority:** P0 · **Type:** constraint · **PRD:** §7 Constraints; DL-001; DL-003

#### SC-015-a — A full collection makes no VDM or write calls  `integration` `green`

- **Given** collect_all with recording fake boto3 clients for every service
- **When** a full collection runs
- **Then** no recorded operation is BatchGetMetricData, ListRecommendations, PutAccountVdmAttributes, CreateExportJob, or any Put, Create, Update, Delete or Set operation
- **Oracle:** not any(op in FORBIDDEN or re.match(r"(Put|Create|Update|Delete|Set)", op) for op in recorder.ops)
- **Test doubles:** recording fake boto3 clients
- **Test:** `tests/test_vdm_coverage_tdd.py::test_sc_015_a_a_full_collection_makes_no_vdm_or_write_calls`

### REQ-016 — Refresh cost stays bounded - at most 120 DNS lookups per refresh with a 7-day cache, and at most 2 ledger aggregate partitions re-read per warm refresh.

**Priority:** P1 · **Type:** non-functional · **PRD:** §13 DNS; §13 Counter reads

#### SC-016-a — DNS lookups capped at 120 per refresh  `integration` `green`

- **Given** 200 distinct recipient domains not in the static map and an empty MX cache
- **When** providers are classified for one refresh
- **Then** at most 120 MX lookups are made and the remainder are classified Other until the next refresh
- **Oracle:** resolver.calls <= 120
- **Test doubles:** counting stub resolver
- **Test:** `tests/test_vdm_coverage_tdd.py::test_sc_016_a_dns_lookups_capped_at_120_per_refresh`

#### SC-016-b — Warm refresh re-reads only the last 2 days  `integration` `green`

- **Given** a data dir with cached aggregates for 365 past days and a counting DynamoDB fake
- **When** ledger aggregates are read
- **Then** Query is called for at most 2 AGG# partitions
- **Oracle:** len({q["pk"] for q in fake.queries}) <= 2
- **Test doubles:** counting DynamoDB fake; tmp_path data dir
- **Test:** `tests/test_vdm_coverage_tdd.py::test_sc_016_b_warm_refresh_re_reads_only_the_last_2_days`
